author: 34th
body:
Map name: Basium
Creators: _TinyBear and Zintenka
Gamemode: DTM
Download link: I don't have a download link but it is on the build server if you want to look at it, the world name is _TinyBear2 (getting a link)
YML: Getting it from Zintenka
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/vb02Q

Features: 
- 2 Punch 1 Bows on each side 
- Diamonds in the middle island
- 3 monuments
- 2 double chests of wood behind spawn
- Enchant table

Huge thanks to Zintenka for helping me and doing the YML!!!

replies.author: Centralking
replies.body:
First off, nice work. I would suggest to take some of the fence posts off near the monuments as it seems overdone as others suggested too. Furthermore, you could narrow the gap in the inner platform (should be closed in more for easy transportation purposes) as I feel like its unnecessary, but it's up to you.  

Maybe try adding diamond blocks at a higher level (covered), sort of like a tower so it gives a higher chance in reaching to them, rather than getting sniped off easily.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Basium, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you make the map more unique. It currently looks way to much like Rendezvous. We also suggest you remove the back monument as the placement of it is weird and there are way too many cobwebs around the monument area.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You May resubmit your map once edited.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
My bad for not responding for a month, but I believe this to be the case. As long as you have a download, you can remix it by default so as long as that download was obtained legally (without WorldDownloader and through a mapmaker/mapdev/post), and you credit the original author when posting it.

However, you can't associate yourself with map series that you do not have partnership with.
